business_rules.text: customer_id must be unique and non-null.
order_id must be unique and non-null.
customer_name must be trimmed before target mapping.
email must be normalized to lowercase.
ACTIVE customer status must normalize to A.
INACTIVE customer status must normalize to I.
SOUTH region must normalize to S.
NORTH region must normalize to N.
EAST region must normalize to E.
WEST region must normalize to W.
OPEN order status must normalize to PENDING.
COMPLETED order status must remain COMPLETED.
CANCELLED order status must remain CANCELLED.
customer balance must be non-negative.
order amount must be greater than zero.
order_date must not be a future date relative to the migration run date.
every order must reference an existing customer_id.
no order may be loaded whose parent customer failed migration.
source data must remain read-only.
only validated records may proceed toward the DEV target.
Customers must be processed before Orders (dependency-ordered load).
re-running the migration must not create duplicate customer_id/order_id rows.
source and target record counts must reconcile for both customers and orders.
SUM(amount) per customer_id must reconcile between source and target.
evidence must capture mappings, transformations, validation, load and reconciliation.
